The path runs through sparse, low-traffic nodes, so it cannot be explained by popularity. The 2-hop neighborhood of 798 contains just 6 nodes (step_09) — no dense connectivity to manufacture spurious routes.
- **Not a static-connectivity artifact**: the binding constraint is real timing. Tightening max_wait to 340 (just below the observed 350 bottleneck) breaks the chain entirely (step_07), and the reverse direction 131→798 is unreachable under identical settings (step_08). A merely ignoring-time connection would be symmetric and wait-insensitive; this one is neither.
- **Edges verified**: the first and last hops are single, directed events oriented 798→132 and 368→131 (step_05, step_06), consistent with forward influence flow.

The cascade is real but fragile — a single thread with no redundant paths (step_03), spanning ~985 time units.
